finalproject

BST260 Final Project — Fall 2026

Author: Zun Cao
Institution: Harvard University

Project Overview

This project explores health patterns and data quality in two US public health datasets.

The analysis focuses on two research questions:

  1. Is sleep duration associated with systolic blood pressure among US adults?
  2. Are waterborne disease outbreaks during summer associated with higher reported illness counts than outbreaks in other seasons?

Datasets

1. NHANES

The National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey provides information on health and lifestyle factors.

We will examine sleep duration, blood pressure, age, gender, and BMI.

2. CDC Waterborne Outbreaks

CDC outbreak surveillance data provide information on reported disease outbreaks in the United States.

We will explore seasonal and regional differences in waterborne disease outbreaks.

Methods

  • Data cleaning and missing data analysis
  • Descriptive statistics
  • Data visualization with ggplot2
  • Regression analysis
  • Discussion of uncertainty and limitations
